[EN] Look, I like bribes as much as the next castanic. Probably more, but I also gave my word. That word is no.

If you want in so badly, start your own guild and build it up. It's not as hard as you think and the rewards can be spectacular.
[ES] Mira, me gustan los sobornos tanto como a cualquier castanic. Probablemente más, pero también di mi palabra. Esa palabra es no.

Si tanto quieres entrar, funda tu propia hermandad y hazla crecer. No es tan difícil como crees y las recompensas pueden ser espectaculares.
